ORDER BY s.stadium_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.stadium_id AS stadiumId, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, s.region AS region, s.capacity AS capacity, s.status AS status, s.latitude AS latitude, s.longitude AS longitude, s.addr1 AS addr1, s.addr2 AS addr2, s.zip AS zip, s.stadium_cost AS stadiumCost, s.stadium_img AS stadiumImg FROM Stadium s WHERE s.stadium_id = #{stadiumId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Stadium ( stadium_id, stadium_name, region, capacity, status, latitude, longitude, addr1, addr2, zip, stadium_cost, stadium_img ) VALUES ( STADIUM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{stadiumName}, #{region}, #{capacity}, 1, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{addr1}, #{addr2}, #{zip}, #{stadiumCost}, #{stadiumImg} )
mapper.update: UPDATE Stadium SET stadium_name = #{stadiumName}, region = #{region}, capacity = #{capacity}, status = #{status}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, addr1 = #{addr1}, addr2 = #{addr2}, zip = #{zip}, stadium_cost = #{stadiumCost}, stadium_img = NVL(#{stadiumImg}, stadium_img) WHERE stadium_id = #{stadiumId}
